topic: Linear Transformations and Matrices: The Geometry of Change

sections.title: Intuition: Transformations as Geometric Movement
lecture_lines: Transformations map vectors to new vectors.
animations: Create a 2D grid plane using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] in #FFFFFF color.
Show an arrow representing a vector moving along the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Show the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] lines distorting to represent a linear map.
Display the transformed vector at its new position relative to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Color the entire scene including the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] to highlight the transformation effect.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Basis Vectors
lecture_lines: Any 2D vector is a basis combination.
Basis vectors are i-hat and j-hat.
Transformations depend on basis vector movement.
animations: Display basis vectors i-hat and j-hat in #FF0000 and #00FF00.
Rotate and scale the i-hat and j-hat vectors.
Highlight how all other vectors depend on these two.

sections.title: The Matrix: Encoding the Transformation
animations: Display a 2x2 matrix with clear numerical labels in #FFFFFF, using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/container.svg] to organize the matrix elements.
Animate the columns of the matrix to match the transformed basis vectors.
Show the matrix multiplication process visually on the plane using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/container.svg] to frame the transformation space.

sections.title: Synthesis: Application in Computer Graphics
lecture_lines: Scaling and rotation are matrix multiplications.
animations: Render a 3D object on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/monitor.svg] using coordinate transforms.
Apply matrix transformation to scale the object.
Animate the object rotating on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg] to show real-time updates.
